dialogues.jp: 「はぁ、はぁ……」
dialogues.en: "Huff, puff......"
dialogues.text: "Huff, puff......"

dialogues.jp: 少々、息を切らせながら早足で学園に向かう。
dialogues.en: I was breathing heavily while walking fast to school.
dialogues.text: I was breathing heavily while walking fast to school.

dialogues.jp: 「ちと起きるのが遅かったかな……」
dialogues.en: "I should have woken up earlier......"
dialogues.text: "I should have woken up earlier......"

dialogues.jp:
テスト直前の朝の教室ってのが、一番集中して
勉強できるもんなんだが……。
dialogues.en:
Studying at the classroom in the last few minutes before the
exam is the best place to focus on studying......
dialogues.text:
Studying at the classroom in the last few minutes before the
exam is the best place to focus on studying......

dialogues.jp:
「でも、夜遅くまでテスト勉強して、朝早く起
　きるのは、ツライ……」
dialogues.en:
"But it's so hard to study until late night and then wake up
early......"
dialogues.text:
"But it's so hard to study until late night and then wake up
early......"

dialogues.jp:
結局、遅めの時間に起きたので、テスト直前に
はあまり勉強する時間が残っていない。
dialogues.en:
There isn't much time left to study now as I woke up late as
usual.
dialogues.text:
There isn't much time left to study now as I woke up late as
usual.

dialogues.jp: 後は、昨日の勉強に全てを託すしかない。
dialogues.en: I have to trust my study from last night.
dialogues.text: I have to trust my study from last night.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.en: "Asakura!?"
dialogues.text: "Asakura!?"

dialogues.jp: 後ろから、眞子の声が聞こえる。
dialogues.en: That was Mako's voice from behind.
dialogues.text: That was Mako's voice from behind.

dialogues.jp: 「あれ、萌先輩は？」
dialogues.en: "Isn't Moe-sempai with you?"
dialogues.text: "Isn't Moe-sempai with you?"

dialogues.jp: 駆け足ぎみにやって来た眞子に声をかける。
dialogues.en: I asked Mako as she jogged towards me.
dialogues.text: I asked Mako as she jogged towards me.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ぐずぐずしてるから、家に置いてきた」
dialogues.en: "I left her at home."
dialogues.text: "I left her at home."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「置いてきたって、薄情な妹だな」
dialogues.en: "You left her?"
dialogues.text: "You left her?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「しょうがないでしょ。今日は試験なんだから。
　それに一応、ギリギリまではずっと待ってた
　んだから」
dialogues.en:
"I had to. It's an exam day. I waited for her until the last
possible minute."
dialogues.text:
"I had to. It's an exam day. I waited for her until the last
possible minute."

dialogues.jp: 息を切らせながら、不満げな顔をする。
dialogues.en: She was running out of breath and made an unhappy face.
dialogues.text: She was running out of breath and made an unhappy face.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「あーもうっ！　あんたと一緒の時間なんて最
　悪！」
dialogues.en: "It's terrible to be as late as you!"
dialogues.text: "It's terrible to be as late as you!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「まあそう言うな。教科書２〜３ページ分なら
　見る時間あるぞ」
dialogues.en:
"Don't get so worked up. We still have time to review two or
three pages."
dialogues.text:
"Don't get so worked up. We still have time to review two or
three pages."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「試験範囲１年分の学年末には意味ない！」
dialogues.en:
"That doesn't mean much when the exam covers the whole
year's worth!"
dialogues.text:
"That doesn't mean much when the exam covers the whole
year's worth!"

dialogues.jp: まあな。
dialogues.en: She has a point.
dialogues.text: She has a point.

dialogues.jp:
なぜか互いに張り合うように加速しながら、学
園へとひた走った……。
dialogues.en: We ran to school like we were in a race......
dialogues.text: We ran to school like we were in a race......

dialogues.jp: ◆眞子だけが登校◆
dialogues.en: ◆Mako going to school◆
dialogues.text: ◆Mako going to school◆

dialogues.jp: ダッシュで学園へと向かう。
dialogues.en: I walked fast to school.
dialogues.text: I walked fast to school.

dialogues.jp:
と、薄情にも姉を置いてきた眞子と出会った。
何故か、張り合うようにして走る二人……。
dialogues.en:
I ran into Mako who left her sister at home. We ran to
school like we were in a race......
dialogues.text:
I ran into Mako who left her sister at home. We ran to
school like we were in a race......
